alt: Real ChatGPT /multiplechoice execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /multiplechoice Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-question multiple-choice widget about training versus inference. Show answer feedback, explanations and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Select the context-only alternative to inspect error feedback.
Check the selected answer and read the training explanation.
Advance to the second question after reviewing the feedback.
Select the explanation that context can affect inference without weight updates.
Check the second answer and read its feedback.
Choose the experiment that keeps the model fixed while changing the input.
Check the final answer and compare the experimental reasoning.
Inspect the 2/3 result and the completed-question counter.
Start another attempt with the same three questions.
Correct the first question by selecting numerical model parameters.
Check the corrected answer and read the updated feedback.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
